name: Yixiang Qingyuan
source:
This game tells a love story about the protagonist who leaves his homeland to study abroad and encounters beautiful girls in other countries. Through his own efforts, he ultimately forms a happy marriage with these beautiful girls.

In the game, you can choose three heroines to pursue, and let's establish a bond with them in a foreign land.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4356170/]Steam[/url]]
